  input [7:0] d,
  input areset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);

                  parameter [1:0] B = 2'b00,
                  parameter [1:0] C = 2'b00;

    if (areset) begin
      q <= 8'b0;
    end else begin
      q <= {C, A, d[3:2]} << 1;
    end
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input d,
  input done_counting,
  input ack,
  input [9:0] state, // 10-bit one-hot current state
  output B3_next,
  output S_next,
  output S1_next,
  output Count_next,
  output Wait_next,
  output done,
  output counting,
  output shift_ena
);

  assign B3_next = d | (done_counting & ack) | (state[0] & ~B3_next); // Example combination
  assign S_next = (d | done_counting) & (ack | state[1]) | (state[2] ^ S_next); // Example combination
  assign S1_next = state[3] & state[4] & d; // Example combination
  assign Count_next = (done_counting | ack) | (state[5] & ~Count_next); // Example combination
  assign Wait_next = state[6] | (d & done_counting) | ~Wait_next; // Example combination
  assign done = state[7] & ack; // Example combination
  assign counting = state[8] ^ d; // Example combination
  assign shift_ena = (state[9] | done) | (shift_ena & ~shift_ena); // Example combination

endmodule
